intro: Recovered from the blighted soil and monstrous dens of Duskwood, this battered tome bears the official stamp of the Royal Library of Stormwind. Titled 'The History of Stormwind,' it vanished prior to the kingdom's reconstruction following the First War. Returning it restores a lost chronicle to Head Librarian Milton Sheaf and begins an effort to preserve Southern human history.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Although the cover of this book is marred by scratches and caked with mud, the words "The History of Stormwind" can still be read along its spine. Upon opening the book, the seal of the Stormwind Library is clearly stamped on the book's first page.
It looks like someone checked out this book, and never returned it...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ooh! What's that old book you have there? Can I see it??

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh my! This book hasn't rested on these shelves since before the rebuilding of Stormwind, years ago. It will have to be restored of course, it's in bad shape, but I would be honored to place it within our rare books collection.
Thank you, friend. Please accept this as payment for returning the book!
